source_excerpt:
Indian Space Research Organization ISRO has released a notification on its official website for the Recruitment of Examination of Technician-B, Heavy Vehicle Driver-A, Light Vehicle Driver-A, Staff Card Driver-A Posts. This recruitment is for 61 positions. The ISRO application form has started on 24 October 2026 , and candidates can apply until 13 November 2026 . Candidates must check the complete details for ISRO URSC Various Post Recruitment 2026 Provided below. ( Advt. No. URSC/04/2026 )

ISRO URSC Various Post Examination 2026 : Short Details
Online Apply Start Date : 24 October 2026
Online Apply Last Date : 13 November 2026
Last Date For Fee Payment : 13 November 2026
Candidates are advised to confirm from the ISRO official website.
Payment Mode (Online): You can make the payment using the following methods:
Debit Card Credit Card Internet Banking IMPS Cash Card / Mobile Wallet
ISRO provides age relaxation for the URSC Various Post position as per their regulations.
Candidates must have Passed Class 10th with ITI / NTC / NAC in Relevant Trade.
Candidates must have Passed Class 10th & Valid LVD License with 03 Years Experience.
Candidates must have Passed Class 10th & Valid HVD License with 05 Years Experience (3 Years as HVD).
Candidates must have Passed Class 10th and Valid LMV Licensee with 03 Years Experience.

Interested candidates who wish to apply for the ISRO post can submit their application online before 13 November 2026.

Make sure to complete the application before the deadline 13 November 2026.
